d:
Enjoy “Chanda Sitare Bindiya Tumhari” from the 1997 Hindi film Naseeb, featuring Govinda and Mamta Kulkarni. Sung by the much-loved voices of Udit Narayan and Alka Yagnik, this romantic duet brings back the charm of classic Hindi film music and the unforgettable melodies of the 90s.
Chanda Sitare Bindiya Tumhari | Naseeb (1997) | Udit-Alka Romantic Hits | Govinda, Mamta Kulkarni
Song: Chanda Sitare Bindiya Tumhari
Movie: Naseeb (1997)
Star Cast: Govinda, Mamta Kulkarni
Singers: Udit Narayan, Alka Yagnik
Music Director: Nadeem Shravan
Lyricist: Sameer
